commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' 3 - 3 What a beauty from just outside the box! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harrison Armstrong (Everton) replaces Tim Iroegbunam.
90+4' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+2' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Merlin Rohl will be replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
90+2' That will be all from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
88' Phil Foden (Manchester City) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Bernardo Silva.
86' Jake O'Brien (Everton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
85' The ball is whipped in from the corner by James Garner (Everton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
83' 3 - 2 GOAL! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Jordan Pickford, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 3:2.
81' 3 - 1 Thierno Barry (Everton) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
80' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
79' Close! Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.

76' Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a brilliant save! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
75' Here is a change. Nico is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Phil Foden (Manchester City) is coming onto the pitch as Antoine Semenyo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' The referee can't ignore those comments and Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) sees a yellow card for bad language.

73' 2 - 1 James Garner sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Jake O'Brien (Everton), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 2:1.
73' James Garner (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
72' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.

71' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jordan Pickford pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
68' 1 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Thierno Barry (Everton), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:1.
66' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.

65' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Gianluigi Donnarumma anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
64' Substitution. Thierno Barry (Everton) in, Beto out.
63' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
61' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

60' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma showed his agility and saved this one.
56' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
55' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
53' James Tarkowski (Everton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
52' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
52' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Everton.
50' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' Beto (Everton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
48' Beto (Everton) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
47' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Manchester City take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Michael Oliver blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Michael Keane (Everton) for his blatant foul.
43' 0 - 1 Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
39' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
37' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jordan Pickford is well positioned and punches the ball away.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City). Manchester City win a corner.
35' Nico (Manchester City) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
32' James Garner (Everton) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
32' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Beto (Everton) inside the box. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
25' James Garner (Everton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
25' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Everton have a corner.
22' Neat passing move from Everton in order to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.
21' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
18' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

18' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
12' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
10' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' A pass into the penalty area from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is intercepted by the defence. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
8' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
7' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
6' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Manchester City earn a corner.
3' Merlin Rohl (Everton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Everton will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
